Maya Chen: FYI, onboarded Alpha customer's LoRA merge into our staging catalog and ran the quick-eval pack. Seeing a small but consistent regression on multi-turn QA (coherence drops around turn 3).
Jon Patel: Screenshot? metrics?
Maya Chen: Pushed results to S3: s3://redwood-ci/alpha/quick-evals/1767777777/results.json 
Maya Chen: Key bits: EM/answer_exact_match down ~3.5 points on conversational subset, single-turn generation looks fine.
Liam O'Sullivan: hmm could be tokenizer mismatch or KV cache order with the adapter. Any diffs in tokenizer vocab or special tokens?
Maya Chen: Tokenizer same as base. No new special tokens. Tests run with 4-bit quantized runtime and fp16 baseline for comparison.
Sophie Martinez: 4-bit can sometimes change sampling logits subtly, especially with LoRA that affects attention weights. Did you run fp16+merged weights as a control?
Maya Chen: Yes — fp16 merged is close to baseline. 4-bit merged is the one with the regression.
Priya Rao: @Maya can you paste the eval command you used?
Maya Chen: ```bash
# quick-eval pack run
redwood-eval run --model alpha-lora-merged --quant int4 --prompts ./evals/alpha/multi_turn_qa.json --seed 42 --out s3://redwood-ci/alpha/quick-evals/1767777777/results.json
```
Jon Patel: Can we repro deterministically with greedy decode to rule out sampling variance?
Maya Chen: Doing that now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for alpha-lora-merged:int4-staging on node pool gpu-v5-4g-24 at 1767777788
Maya Chen: Greedy run attached — same pattern, coherence drops after prompt+2. Logs show token overlap oddity near turn boundary.
Liam O'Sullivan: Do you see any offending tokens inserted (like delimiter tokens) or misaligned attention masks?
Maya Chen: Found some cases where a trailing space token tokenized differently in int4 path — likely due to quantized kernel rounding.
Sophie Martinez: Can you run the same merged model with quantize-to-int4 but using alternative kernel (fallback nvllm vs our optimized int4)? Might isolate if it's kernel-specific.
Maya Chen: Good call. Spinning that up.
Priya Rao: Also run a small embedding drift test on the prompts to see if representation shifts enough to affect later decoding.
Maya Chen: Ran nvllm int4 path: regression drops to ~1.0 point, so our int4 kernel seems to amplify the issue.
Jon Patel: OK that points to kernel numerical behavior interacting with LoRA deltas. Two mitigation threads: 1) use nvllm int4 kernel for Alpha for now; 2) adjust quantization calibration or fallback to fp16 for conversational routes.
Liam O'Sullivan: We should also test merging adapter with per-channel quantization-aware calibration. Try KL-based calibration on the LoRA deltas.
Sophie Martinez: I'll prepare a small calibration job; can reuse the customer's prompt trace for calibration set.
Maya Chen: Action items: 
- Maya: open a PR to pin quant-kernel to nvllm for alpha-lora-merged on staging and roll traffic for canary tests.
- Sophie: run per-channel calibration + eval and post results.
- Liam: instrument tokenization boundary checks in int4 runtime to emit a warning if whitespace tokenization flips.
- Jon: update rollback playbook to force fp16 variant on conversational routes for this customer if production sees regression.
Priya Rao: ETA?
Maya Chen: PR in 20m, canary run in ~1h. Sophie expects calibration results in 3-4h.
Jon Patel: Thx team. If canary looks good, coordinate with SE to notify Alpha about temporary kernel pin (explain perf tradeoff).
Sophie Martinez: I'll add a short note in the eval results: "int4 optimized kernel shows numeric divergence with LoRA deltas; nvllm int4 reduces regression. Calibration pending." :memo:
Liam O'Sullivan: Quick check — are unit tests covering whitespace tokenization under quantized kernels? If not, add one.
Maya Chen: Not currently. Adding a tiny test vector to the runtime test-suite.
deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1767777835: alpha-lora-merged:int4 pinned to nvllm on 10% traffic, no errors reported.
Maya Chen: Canary metrics look promising — conversational EM back within 0.8 points.
Priya Rao: Great. Once Sophie posts calibrated-int4 numbers, we'll decide final pin or calibrate-and-release.
Jon Patel: Good job triaging — short recap for release notes?
Maya Chen: "Fix: mitigated conversational regressions for Alpha customer's LoRA-merged model by pinning to nvllm int4 kernel during rollout; calibration pending. Perf tradeoff: ~6% throughput drop on that kernel."
Sophie Martinez: Uploading calibration artifacts to s3://redwood-ci/alpha/quick-evals/1767777777/calibration/
Liam O'Sullivan: I'll follow up with an internal RFC to make tokenization boundary checks part of int4 release checklist.
Priya Rao: :thumbsup:
